name: CreateAccessToken

parameters.description_en: The name of the activation code. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 激活码名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。

parameters.description_en:
The maximum number of times that the activation code can be used to register migration sources. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 100.

激活码用于注册迁移源的使用次数上限。取值范围为1~1000。

默认值为100。

parameters.description_en:
The validity period of the activation code, in days. The activation code cannot be used to register new instances after it expires. Valid values: 1 to 90.

Default value: 30.
